memory.note: Wraps existing CuPy allocator and retains original memory owners across threads, including pool-bypassing allocations. peak_tracked_live_bytes is peak requested live storage allocated inside the context. peak_live_bytes adds the fixed initial_pool_live_bytes offset and can overcount preexisting pool storage later freed. Native/preexisting nonpool storage is excluded. Pool reserved and process RSS are separate; VmHWM is current address-space RSS high-water. On unified-memory GB10 do not sum metrics. Fresh process per variant; timing is diagnostic only.

note: Single controls establish scaling only. Profiles synchronize inclusive nested scopes. Memory is requested CuPy storage and separate process RSS, not hardware-wide RAM.
